for: T-115 (Codex fit search on the face-round-4 parameters). Paths are spec keys under face (dotted); every value is an override on the current spec (boy 2.1.0, girl 0.12.0) on top of the T-109 candidate. Ranges are where the T-109 checks (test_face_v4.py: folds, 3/4 rim, blink residue, lid line at glance, shelf) were seen to hold or are expected to; outside them, re-run test_face_v4.py on the result.

lower_face.note: face_v3/lower_face.py (new, opt-in) and the face_generic/2 outline options. Lengths in metres.

shape.lower_face.jaw_round_m.note: jaw_down > 0.2 with jaw_round_m >= 0.01 leaves a crease along the boy's jaw in 3/4

eye_opening.note: Eyeball shape and lid edges (face_generic/2-3). Girl: x scale above about 1.03 sharpens the eye-corner fold past the published limit and raises the 3/4 rim above 10 % (T-089b).

eyes.lids.upper_edge_deg.note: girl 52 hid the lid line in a 15 deg glance (T-089b)

lid_profile.note: Lid curve, roll (D-shaped opening) and the T-109 lower-lid fit.

eyes.lids.lower_fit.gap.note: girl only (oval eye under glasses); 0.02 still left a pale band (lower-lid exposure 0.28), 0.005 hides it (0.05)
